entries.title: Exodus 27:1
segments: And you shall make an altar of acacia-wood, five cubits long and five cubits broad. The altar shall be square. And the height of it [shall be] three cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 27:2
segments: And you shall make the horns of it upon the four corners of it. Its horns shall be of the same, and you shall overlay it [with] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:3
segments: And you shall make its pans to receive its ashes, and its shovels, and its basins, and its flesh-hooks, and its fire-pans. All the vessels of it you shall make [of] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:4
segments: And you shall make for it a grate of network [of] bronze. And upon the net you shall make four bronze rings in the four corners of it.

entries.title: Exodus 27:5
segments: And you shall put it under the ledge of the altar beneath, so that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

entries.title: Exodus 27:6
segments: And you shall make staves for the altar, staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlay them [with] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:7
segments: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to carry it.

entries.title: Exodus 27:8
segments: You shall make it hollow [with] boards; as it was shown you in the mountain, so shall they make [it].

entries.title: Exodus 27:9
segments: And you shall make the court of the tabernacle. For the south side southward there [shall be] hangings for the court [of] fine twined bleached [linen], of a hundred cubits long for one side.

entries.title: Exodus 27:10
segments: And the twenty pillars of it, and their twenty sockets, [shall be] of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands shall be of silver.

entries.title: Exodus 27:11
segments: And so for the north side in length, hangings of a hundred cubits long. And its twenty pillars and their twenty sockets shall be [of] bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their bands [of] silver.

entries.title: Exodus 27:12
segments: And [for] the breadth of the court on the west side [shall be] hangings of fifty cubits. Their pillars [shall be] ten, and their sockets ten.

entries.title: Exodus 27:13
segments: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward [shall be] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Exodus 27:14
segments: The hangings of one side [of the gate shall be] fifteen cubits. Their pillars shall be three, and their sockets three;

entries.title: Exodus 27:15
segments: and on the other side hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

entries.title: Exodus 27:16
segments: And for the gate of the court [shall be] a screen of twenty cubits, [of] blue and purple and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen], worked with needlework; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

entries.title: Exodus 27:17
segments: All the pillars around the court [shall be] banded [with] silver; their hooks silver, and their sockets [of] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:18
segments: The length of the court [shall be] a hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty cubits [of] everywhere, and the height five cubits of fine twined bleached [linen], and their sockets bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:19
segments: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service of it, and all the pins of it, and all the pins of the court, [shall be] bronze.

entries.title: Exodus 27:20
segments: And you shall command the sons of Israel that they bring you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always

entries.title: Exodus 27:21
segments: in the tabernacle of the congregation, outside the veil which [is] before the testimony. Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD. [It shall be] a statute forever to their generations on behalf of the sons of Israel.
